subject: geography
general_outcomes: By the end of Senior Secondary, the learner should be able to:
Demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between Geography and other disciplines for career development
Apply appropriate geographical knowledge, skills, values and attitudes as a basis for technological and industrial development
Manage and conserve the physical and human environments for socio-economic development
Appreciate the interdependence between the Earth’s systems and processes for environmental sustainability
Use individual talents and geographical skills for self-reliance and spatial interactions at local, national, regional and global levels

Discuss development of Jua Kali industries in Kenya (including cultural), cottage industries in India and car manufacturing in Japan and present in class
Write a request for establishing a cottage industry and model the industry in the school
Write an article on the problems associated with industrialization and their possible solutions in Kenya and publish
Carry out field study on effects of industries on environment (pollution, informal settlements among others) and write a report
Create a portfolio on effects of industries on environment and display in the school
Develop communication messages on consumer concerns on development of industries
Suggested Learning Resources
inquiry_questions: What is the status and prospects of industrialization in Kenya?
core_competencies: • Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: The skill of open-mindedness as the learner writes a request and models a cottage
values: Social Justice: Learner has freedom as they develop communication messages on consumer concerns about development of industries
